description: Smoke test of the campus-customs MCP server. Each tool was called by the vibe coder (Claude Code) over the live MCP connection configured in .mcp.json, then every returned value was checked against data/campus_customs_new.db with SQL.
vibe_coder: Claude Code (desktop app), project MCP server 'campus-customs' from .mcp.json
db_note: Run in Problem 4, before any payments: at that time every tool output matched data/campus_customs_new.db (19/19 checks). check_stock and get_pricing still match the final working copy. get_lease no longer does, by design: in Problem 9 rent payment #2 ($2,400.00, lease 1) moved leases.next_due from 2026-09-02 to 2026-10-02 (see the Cash tab of output/desk_tickets.html). Running get_lease(1) against the original data/campus_customs.db still returns exactly the values recorded below (due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the 2026-08-31 desk date).

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants 1 Classic Bulldog Tee (CC-TEE-WHITE) in size S. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check whether we can fill it from stock.

db_check.sql: SELECT sku, name, size, qty, location FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'CC-TEE-WHITE' ORDER BY rowid; SELECT date_today FROM desk;

tests.what_it_shows: Size S has 0 on hand, so ticket 101 can't be filled from the shelf (shortfall 1); M, L and XL are in stock.

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed that rent is due. Use the campus-customs MCP server to look up lease 1 so we can check the notice against the lease on file.

db_check.sql: SELECT * FROM leases WHERE id = 1; SELECT date_today FROM desk;

tests.what_it_shows: The lease on file is $2,400 to Elm City Properties, due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the desk date, matching what the notice claims.

tests.prompt: Ticket 103: Yale AI Club wants 20 Basic Hoodie Big Yale (CC-HOOD-NAVY) with a bulk discount. Use the campus-customs MCP server to get the pricing for 20 so we know the full-price quote and the cost floor.

db_check.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.unit_cost, p.list_price, (SELECT name FROM inventory i WHERE i.sku = p.sku LIMIT 1) AS name FROM pricing p WHERE p.sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY';

tests.what_it_shows: 20 hoodies are $1,160 at list and $440 at cost, so any discount must stay above $22 a unit (at most 62.1% off).
